qualification.details: Scientific Assistant : Full Time Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering (from a recognized University/ Institute with aggregate of 60% marks). Knowledge on use of personal computers and its applications. Minimum 2 years experience in the Electronic Workshops in the areas of modelling, programming and use of 3D printers, PCB designing, circuit debugging, SMD soldering, use of basic electronic workshop equipment, programming of microcontroller like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, sensors and their applications and integration with the microcontroller, prototype assembly and hardware validation testing.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NCBS Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCBS to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Scientific Assistant : Full Time Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering (from a recognized University/ Institute with aggregate of 60% marks). Knowledge on use of personal computers and its applications. Minimum 2 years experience in the Electronic Workshops in the areas of modelling, programming and use of 3D printers, PCB designing, circuit debugging, SMD soldering, use of basic electronic workshop equipment, programming of microcontroller like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, sensors and their applications and integration with the microcontroller, prototype assembly and hardware validation testing.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCBS Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications for the NCBS Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) post is 09 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) in NCBS?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) post in the National Centre for Biological Sciences recruitment drive for 2026. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) position should not be more than 28 years of age as on 01 January 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for NCBS Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop)?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Full Time Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering with 60% marks and a minimum of 2 years of experience in Electronic Workshops. Specific technical skills are also required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NCBS Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NCBS Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) at NCBS?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) position at NCBS involves two stages: a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must qualify in both stages for final selection.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the NCBS Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) post?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of NCBS (www.ncbs.res.in) or by using the direct apply link provided in the Important Links section of this article. Ensure all details are correct.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the job location be for the Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) position will be in Bangalore, Karnataka. NCBS is located in this city, offering a vibrant work environment in biological sciences.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual position?
faq.answer: The Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) position at NCBS is a Contractual job type. Candidates should review the official notification for details regarding the duration and terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this NCBS recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the NCBS Scientific Assistant (Electronic workshop) Recruitment 2026 is 12/2026. This number can be used to reference the specific notification on the official website.
